SPECIAL COMMODITY LEVY ACT, No. 48 OF 2007
Order under Section 2

BY virtue of the powers vested in me under Section 2 of the Special Commodity Levy Act, No. 48 of 2007, I, MangalaSamaraweera, Minister of Finance of the Democratic Socialist Republic of Sri Lanka, do by this order impose in respectof the list of commodities specified in Column I of the Schedule hereto, a Special Commodity Levy at the rates specifiedin the corresponding entries in Column II of that Schedule.
This Order shall be valid for a period of thirty one days commencing from July 11, 2019, subject to provisions ofSub Section (3) of Section 2 of the Special Commodity Levy Act, No. 48 of 2007.

The Order made under Section 2 of the Special Commodity Levy Act, No. 48 of 2007 and published inthe Extraordinary Gazette Notification No. 2111/58 of 24.02.2019 and the Extraordinary Gazette NotificationNo. 2124/2 of 21.05.2019 in respect of Dates (HS Codes 0804.10.10, 0804.10.20) and the Extraordinary GazetteNotification No. 2090/47 of 29.09.2018 in respect of Oranges (HS Codes 0805.10.10) an Apples (HS Codes 0808.10)are rescinded with effect from July 11, 2019.
MANGALA SAMARAWEERA,Minister of Finance.Ministry of Finance,Colombo 01,July 10, 2019.
